message.content: {"question":"A planet describes an elliptical orbit around a star. Let ω = dθ/dt its angular velocity and r its distance from the center of the star in a given instant. Is the following relationship correct?","options":{"A":"ω · r = constant","B":"ω/r = constant","C":"ω/r² = constant","D":"ω · r² = constant"},"correct":"A"}
